release_notes: Hardening for the October 2026 nginx advisories (up to CVSS 9.2): the generated nginx vhost no longer uses the alias directive — new installs ship it, existing installs are regenerated and reloaded automatically right after the update (rollback if nginx -t fails, asset delivery never breaks mid-update). A new dashboard banner covers the OS-package half of the advisories (nginx package, kernel, CA certificates) with the exact commands; it reads nginx -v and hides itself on a fixed build. The tracker itself is not exposed to the PostgreSQL/Redis/Node.js items of the same digest (PHP + SQLite, no Node on the server). No migration; suite 144/144.
